##### SECTION M8 (the server receive argv (B-2a): -o canmount/readonly/volmode + -x mountpoint/sharenfs/sharesmb/setuid/exec/devices + -h on plain/raw filesystems and volumes, -p, holds, resume, -F onto an existing copy, server-side operations, ancestors)  tag=C  zfs-2.1.5-1ubuntu6~22.04.7
#note: fixtures: fsp = hostile plain fs (mountpoint=/var/tmp/zfsb-matrix/m8-fsp then /var/tmp/zfsb-matrix/m8-fsp2, canmount=on setuid/exec/devices=on readonly=off volmode=dev sharenfs=on then ro, sharesmb=on, forged org.zfsbackup:*) @a @b @c; efs = the same, encrypted (key loaded); zvp/zve = 8M volumes (volmode=dev readonly=off), plain / encrypted, @a @b @c; hs = plain fs for holds. srvm / esrvm = server parents created with 'zfs create -u -o canmount=noauto -o org.zfsbackup:client_id=x' (esrvm encrypted, key loaded), mountpoint set to a temp path so a wrongly mounted copy would show
=== CASE M8/C0.hostile_create_and_share
--- cmd
zfs create -o mountpoint=/var/tmp/zfsb-matrix/m8-probe -o canmount=on -o sharenfs=on zfsbcapc/M8/probe; echo create_rc=$?; zfs set sharesmb=on zfsbcapc/M8/probe; echo set_sharesmb_rc=$?; zfs set sharenfs=ro zfsbcapc/M8/probe; echo set_sharenfs_rc=$?; zfs get -H -o name,property,value,source sharenfs,sharesmb,mounted zfsbcapc/M8/probe
--- rc
0
--- stdout
create_rc=0
set_sharesmb_rc=1
set_sharenfs_rc=1
zfsbcapc/M8/probe	sharenfs	ro	local
zfsbcapc/M8/probe	sharesmb	on	local
zfsbcapc/M8/probe	mounted	yes	-
--- stderr
cannot share 'zfsbcapc/M8/probe: system error': SMB share creation failed
cannot share 'zfsbcapc/M8/probe: system error': SMB share creation failed
=== END

=== CASE M8/C2.8.5_zfs_share_each

=== CASE M8/C2.8.8_unmount_what_share_mounted
--- cmd

=== CASE M8/C7.m.8_unmount_what_share_mounted
--- cmd
for i in 1 2 3; do for d in $(zfs mount | awk '{print $1}' | grep -F 'zfsbcapc/M8/srvm/' | tac); do zfs unmount "$d" 2>/dev/null; done; done; zfs mount | grep -F 'zfsbcapc/M8/srvm/'; echo grep_rc=$?
--- rc
0
--- stdout
grep_rc=1
--- stderr
=== END

#note: 14: HDR.* = the first 312 bytes of the stream as one line of hex (od -An -v -tx1), preceded by 'bytes=N'. Byte order of the host: see C11.0_host. Sources: fsp@a/@b (plain fs), efs@a/@b (raw fs), zvp@a (volume), zve@a (raw volume)
=== CASE M8/HDR.plain_full
--- cmd
set +o pipefail; h=$(zfs send zfsbcapc/M8/fsp@a | head -c 312 | od -An -v -tx1 | tr -d ' \n'); echo bytes=$((${#h}/2)); echo $h
--- rc
0
--- stdout
bytes=312

--- stderr
=== END
